name: @veren/notebook-ui
description: Use when the @veren/notebook Host service is installed and a person needs to open, read, create, edit, and delete a preset's private notes in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI; it adds the "notebook" sidebar entry and the owner-selector page, mounts the `notebook` Remote namespace, and writes through the same service methods the `notebook_*` tools use. Skip it for a headless, ACP, or SDK profile, where the Host service and its tools already cover every operation.
